scope: Extend opt-in screenshot redaction to non-input answer controls: contenteditable values except explicit false, ARIA textboxes and ARIA comboboxes. Cover three synthetic answers with headless Chromium pixel-level acceptance and document the supported masks.

test_first_red.observation: Before implementation, the unit mask-selector assertion failed because rich-control selectors were absent; Chromium showed a synthetic answer pixel (23, 23, 23) instead of the opaque black mask (0, 0, 0).

acceptance.contenteditable_answer_masked: PASS - Pixel assertion confirms synthetic plaintext-only contenteditable answer is covered.
acceptance.aria_textbox_answer_masked: PASS - Pixel assertion confirms synthetic ARIA textbox answer is covered.
acceptance.aria_combobox_answer_masked: PASS - Pixel assertion confirms synthetic ARIA combobox answer is covered.
acceptance.issue_requirement_complete: false - Arbitrary private values in ordinary text and text rendered into images/canvas remain outside reliable automatic recognition.

commands.notes: Windows Python 3.12 repository virtual environment; headless Chromium synthetic DOM; GUI test uses temporary output directories.

commands.command: python -m py_compile cli/live_feedback.py tests/unit/test_live_feedback.py tests/browser/test_live_feedback_redaction.py; python -m cli.live_feedback run --help

python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

environment.browser: headless Chromium against synthetic in-memory HTML; no external navigation

limitations: Masking now covers standard controls plus contenteditable, ARIA textbox and combobox controls; arbitrary private free-form text outside controls is still not classified reliably.
Text embedded in images/canvas and other non-DOM pixels is not inspected.
Issue #181 / MJ-REQ-180 remains OPEN/PARTIAL for unclassifiable values and other debug-data surfaces.
The full repository suite, frontend build, database/container workflows and hosted verification were not run.
A test-created untracked events.jsonl in the isolated worktree was preserved and excluded from Git.
